provenance_notes: HD D0(2023) is inferred using the same atomic IP_H and IP_D, thus error covariance is not known or independent.
H2 D0(2026) is inferred using atomic hydrogen IP; the datasets may share metrological correlations.
Sum of reported absolute uncertainty magnitudes is neither a confidence interval nor a certified worst-case bound.
H2 J=1 is ortho, H2 J=0 is para; the level difference is internal molecular spectroscopy, not an assumed thermal mixture.
GL2022 SQM scattering threshold may employ its PES-based Born-Oppenheimer/asymptotic convention, not automatically the full corrected spectroscopic one.
No 2019 ground-to-ground 39.5 meV substituted as state-specific Q.
